Throne-court and host-of-heaven language overlaps the listed divine-council alternative, but no consensus primary or alternative equates elders with constellations/stars. That astronomical identification is therefore absent rather than a narrowing, broadening, or direct replacement of a settled referent, so the relation is NOVEL.","citation_support":"PARTIAL","strongest_objection":"The book could be read as only a celestial specification of the already-listed heavenly-council/host alternative (same texts: 1 Kgs 22; Isa 24; Ps 89; Rev 4), which would make the relation REFINED or DIVERGENT rather than NOVEL.","confidence":"medium"}
